page_title: GEN 3-0 TOR | Genoa v Torino 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
89' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
88' Jean Onana (Genoa) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post.
87' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Genoa.
84' Daniele De Rossi prepares a substitution. Ruslan Malinovskyi is replaced by Jean Onana (Genoa).
83' 3 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Junior Messias (Genoa), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 3:0.
83' Rafael Obrador comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marcus Pedersen (Torino).
82' Duvan Zapata (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
81' Amorim (Genoa) brings an opponent down and Marco Guida interrupts the game.
80' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
79' The resulting corner from Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is cleared.
78' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Now Genoa have a corner.
76' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) commits a rough foul. Marco Guida stops the game and makes a call.
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:6.
74' Junior Messias (Genoa) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
72' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
71' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Brooke Norton-Cuffy and he is replaced by Stefano Sabelli (Genoa).
70' The ball falls for Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there!
68' Substitution. Giovanni Simeone will be replaced by Alieu Njie (Torino).
68' Duvan Zapata (Torino) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low into the middle of the goal, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Tommaso Baldanzi as he is replaced by Amorim (Genoa).
65' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Junior Messias (Genoa) replaces Caleb Ekuban.
65' Here comes a substitution. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Lorenzo Colombo.
64' Torino enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
62' Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa) is penalised for a foul. Marco Guida had a clear view and blows his whistle.
62' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
60' Substitution. Duvan Zapata (Torino) in, Sandro Kulenovic out.
58' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:1.
56' Matteo Prati (Torino) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
54' Good chance! Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
53' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
51' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
48' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' Marco Baroni makes a half-time substitution. Matteo Prati comes on in place of Enzo Ebosse (Torino).
46' Marco Baroni has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ardian Ismajli (Torino) comes on the pitch for Guillermo Maripan.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Guida starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The game is interrupted now, Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+2' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
45+1' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Referee Marco Guida signals NO PENALTY for Torino after a VAR review!
43' There's a break in play and referee Marco Guida must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Torino using VAR. This could be interesting!
43' Surely that's handball by one of the Genoa players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
42' Rafael Obrador (Torino) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Torino.
40' 2 - 0 Goal! Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:0.
40' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
38' Rafael Obrador (Torino) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
38' The ball is cleared after Nikola Vlasic (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
35' A snap shot by Rafael Obrador (Torino) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Justin Bijlow flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.

33' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post.
33' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) on the edge of the box.
32' Enzo Ebosse (Torino) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Genoa earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
31' 4:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
28' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Nikola Vlasic (Torino), but the defence gets it clear.
26' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
25' An attempted cross from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is cleared.
24' Great teamplay by Torino as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
21' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
18' A crossfield pass from Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) fails to find any of his teammates.
17' The Genoa players are exchanging some short passes.
15' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
13' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but Alberto Paleari comes off his line to gather the ball.
11' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
11' The foul by Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) was seen by Marco Guida who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
8' The percentage of ball possession is – 73:27.
7' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) tries to find Lorenzo Colombo, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
5' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
4' Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
1' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Torino will have the kick-off.
Marco Guida will supervise the game today.
